notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). OpenShift reference: oc login and projects, deploying from images/source (S2I)/templates, Routes and A/B weights, BuildConfigs, ImageStreams, DeploymentConfigs, ConfigMaps/Secrets, Security Context Constraints, Operator subscriptions, monitoring and image-pull secrets.

Medium: following it has the agent run `oc` commands against the user's cluster that log in with credentials (SKILL.md:35-38), create and delete projects (`oc delete project myapp`, SKILL.md:62), deploy apps and builds, create secrets, subscribe to community operators, and grant the `anyuid` SCC to a service account (SKILL.md:350), which relaxes pod security. Acceptable because these are standard operations for the user's own OpenShift work and the skill's best practices say to use appropriate SCCs and avoid privileged; the agent should confirm before deleting projects or granting anyuid.

Usernames/passwords/tokens (admin/password, sha256~xxxx, secret123, user/pass) are placeholders; passing passwords with -p/--from-literal exposes them in shell history. DeploymentConfig is deprecated in recent OpenShift in favour of Deployment. Related Skills (SKILL.md:459-461) link to ../kubernetes-ops/, ../helm-charts/ and ../../containers/container-registries/, which do not ship; optional pointers. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
